task: Detached annotated engineering SVG object edits
tool_contract_requirement: Freeze exact schemas, packages, call limits and feedback before each screened task batch; identical access for competing systems; no hidden reference access.
admission: All three independent completed attempts retain a substantive geometry/edit failure after allowed feedback; references and evaluator independently audited.
split_policy: Component-disjoint source ancestry and geometry-family checks before augmentation; evaluation benchmarks and all their variants remain out of training.
reporting: Keep all discovery outcomes visible; selected failure-only subset is conditional on this model and budget, not a population failure-rate estimate or proof of incapability.
